summary.zh: 审查代码改动是否过度设计、偏离原目标
summary.en: Review diffs for overbuilt abstractions and hidden assumptions

description.zh: 对照 Karpathy 的四条原则检查一处改动：有没有隐藏假设、多余的抽象、和目标无关的顺手修改。适合提交前自查，或觉得自己把问题做复杂了、需要重新确认范围的时候。
description.en: Checks a diff against four principles: hidden assumptions, needless abstraction, unrelated edits and unverified goals. Good before a commit, or when you suspect a problem has been made harder than it needed to be.
